notes: Modified cash basis village, FYE 9/30/2022. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); no governmental transfers. Business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary funds statement Total column (p7); expenses tie to the Statement of Activities (149,889, p2). Proprietary transfers net to zero in the Total column (Water -10,000, Solid Waste +10,000), so transfers_net is null; per-fund transfers are in detail. business_type measure net position (modified cash net position: cash, certificates of deposit and restricted cash, as in FY2025); proprietary cash flows left null as in FY2023-FY2025. Water 'Miscellaneous income' 3,075 categorized charges for services because the Statement of Activities counts it in Water charges for services. Statement capital outlay 16,539 spans Fire, Pool, RV Park and Street columns, so it keeps the plain label. Fund balances from p5; beginning cash not printed (null); ending cash = cash and cash equivalents + county treasurer cash (p4), certificates of deposit as investments. Balance sheet: governmental funds balance sheet (p4; totals equal the government-wide Statement of Net Position p1) plus proprietary statement of net position (p6); totals from p1. Detail: General Fund from the departments combining schedule (p10-11, one line per department column); Street Fund and the Water, Sewer and Solid Waste funds from their fund columns on p5 and p7 (no own schedules). The all-funds budgetary comparison schedule (p9) is not recorded (combined, less detailed). Read pages 1-11 of 11
